subject: Nile
text: Traveling South along the Nile leads endlessly until you need to head back North, so head North.

evidence.quote:
There is paths leading North and South, but if you travel 
    South you will travel along the Nile endlessly and eventually need 
    to head back North again so just head North.

subject: Guard
text: Continuing North reveals a guard blocking your path, so head to the boat docked at the small oasis next.

evidence.quote:
Eventually you will come upon a small oasis with some people and a boat docked nearby. 
    If you continue North you will see a guard blocking your path, so 
    heading to the boat is what you want to do next.

subject: Ship Guard
text: If you try to enter the cabin before talking to everyone outside on the ship, the guard will not let you pass until you have talked with everyone outside.

evidence.quote:
If you enter the cabin before talking to 
    everyone outside on the ship the guard will not let you pass. Once 
    you have talked with everyone outside the ship he will let you 
    enter.

subject: Cleopatra
text: Cleopatra tells Mike she can help him search for the tetrads, but he must first get a pizza for her.

evidence.quote:
Inside you Mike meets with Cleopatra who asks his business 
    and he tells her he is searching for the tetrads. Cleopatra says 
    that she can help you but you must first get a pizza for her.

subject: Ridge Cave
text: After talking to Cleopatra, the person blocking the path lets you through to get pizza, and proceeding a little south leads to the cave.

evidence.quote:
Now that you 
    have talked to Cleopatra he will tell you this is the way to get 
    pizza and let you through. Proceed a little south and you will find 
    the cave.

subject: Ridge Cave
text: A map layout exists for Ridge Cave spanning Rooms 1 through 13.

evidence.quote:
LEGEND FOR RIDGE CAVE
    1 = Starting Point for Yum Yum Cave
    12 = BOSS: Big Scorpion
    13 = Leads to Overworld

subject: Room 1
text: In Room 1, head North to Room 2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Just a usual entrance. Head North to ROOM #2.

subject: Room 2
text: In Room 2, defeat the three spiders and the East wall will open up allowing you to head to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    This room just has three spiders. Defeat them and the East wall 
    will open up allowing you to head to ROOM #3.

subject: Room 3
text: In Room 3, defeat the one cyclops and the East wall will open up allowing you to head to Room 4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There is one cyclops in here. Defeat him and the East wall will 
    open up allowing you to head to ROOM #4.

subject: Slingshot
text: In Room 4, jump on the tile for a question mark to appear, which opens the chest revealing a slingshot.

evidence.quote:
When you first enter you will see a tile and a treasure chest. 
    You must jump on this tile for a question mark to appear. Once 
    you get that question mark, then the chest will open revealing 
    a slingshot.

subject: Room 4
text: In Room 4, jump around avoiding spiders and take the path leading North.

evidence.quote:
Jump around this room carefully avoiding getting
    hit by the spiders and take the path leading North.

subject: Room 5
text: In Room 5, defeat the two porcupines to open the door and head North to Room 6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    There are two porcupines in here that you must defeat to open 
    the door and head North to ROOM #6.

subject: Room 6
text: In Room 6, defeat the three cyclops to open the door and head East to Room 7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    There are three cyclops in here that you must defeat to open 
    the door and head East to ROOM #7.

subject: Room 7
text: In Room 7, defeat the four scorpions to reveal a door to the East Room 8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    There are four scorpions in here that you must defeat to reveal 
    a door to the East ROOM #8.

subject: Room 8
text: In Room 8, defeat or avoid the four underground enemies and head to the East and Room 9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There are four underground enemies in here that you can defeat 
    or simply avoid and head to the East and ROOM #9.

subject: Room 9
text: In Room 9, defeat the four underground enemies and two porcupines to open a door to the North and Room 10.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    There are four underground enemies and two porcupines in here that 
    you must defeat to open a door to the North and ROOM #10.

subject: Room 10
text: In Room 10, which contains three spiders and two scorpions, hop up and around to go North to Room 11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    This room has three spiders and two scorpions who you don't have to 
    defeat but it is much easier to get through this room if you do. 
    You must hop up and around to go North to ROOM #11.

subject: Room 11
text: In Room 11, which has two porcupines and a couple spiders, make a couple jumps to reach the path North to Room 12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11:
    There are two porcupines when you first enter the room, as well as 
    a couple more spiders...take you to ROOM #12.

subject: Big Scorpion
text: The Big Scorpion flashes red and shoots a spray of shots from his tail, which should be jumped over while keeping an eye on the little scorpions.

evidence.quote:
The big scorpion will flash red 
    and then shoot out a spray of shots from his tail. If you time it 
    right it should be easy to jump over his shots, just keep an eye on 
    the little scorpions.

subject: Room 12
text: Once Big Scorpion is defeated, the door opens to the West and Room 13.

evidence.quote:
Once he is defeated the door will open to the WEST and
    ROOM #13.

subject: Room 13
text: Room 13 is an exit leading North to the Overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    Just an exit. Head North to the Overworld.

subject: Camel
text: In the middle of the desert, you must rent a camel from the man to the East, as walking in any direction fails.

evidence.quote:
To his East is a man with a camel. Go over to him and he 
    will ask you if you want to rent a camel. You can say NO but if you 
    try to walk in any direction you will quickly see that you will need 
    to say YES to him.

subject: Pizza
text: After riding the camel for a very long time, you meet the pizza delivery guy who gives you the pizza.

evidence.quote:
You will then ride for a very long time until 
    eventually you spot what reminds me of a goomba on a koopa troopa 
    from Super Mario Bros. He informs you that he is the pizza delivery 
    guy and gives you the pizza.

subject: Cleopatra
text: After you give Cleopatra the pizza, she takes you across the Nile in her boat, drops you off on the shore, and tells you to head to the Pyramids to the South.

evidence.quote:
You hurry back to the boat and give Cleopatra the pizza...She will then take 
    you across the NIle in her boat and drop you off on the shore. She 
    will tell you to head to the Pyramids to the South.

subject: Dagger
text: Cleopatra trades your axe for a dagger.

evidence.quote:
She also trades 
    your axe for a dagger.

subject: Western side of the Nile
text: On the western side of the Nile, head North until you find a small peninsula with some green patches, avoiding wandering West.

evidence.quote:
You are dropped off on the western side of the Nile. You can head 
    North or South but if you head West you will be wandering the desert 
    for ever. My suggestion would be to head North until you find a 
    small peninsula with some green patches.

subject: Monkey Maze Part 1
text: An ASCII map is provided for Monkey Maze Part 1 showing starting point O and exit X.

evidence.quote:
- - - M O N K E Y  M A Z E  P A R T # 1 - - -

             LEGEND FOR MONKEY MAZE PART #1
                       O = Starting Point
                       X = Exit

subject: Monkey Maze Part 1
text: In Monkey Maze Part 1, circle clockwise in the grass around the deck from below and left to the lower right hand side, then move up and down to the right and up the right side.

evidence.quote:
You will want to do a clockwise circle in the grass around 
    the deck. Where you start at the part of the grass below and to the 
    left from the initial deck and end up on the lower right hand side. 
    You then love up and down to the right and then up the right side. 
    You should come out of the grass near a BIG HEART.

subject: Big Heart
text: You can find a BIG HEART coming out of the grass in the Savannah before falling into a mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
You should come out of the grass near a BIG HEART. After just a few 
    step you will fall into a mini-dungeon

subject: Savannah Dungeon A
text: A map layout exists for Savannah Dungeon A spanning Rooms 1 through 6.

evidence.quote:
- - - S A V A N N A H  D U N G E O N   A - - -

                       LEGEND FOR SAVANNAH DUNGEON A
                       1 = Starting Point
             [6]       6 = Exit

subject: Room 1
text: In Savannah Dungeon A Room 1, there is nothing, so go to Room 2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Here you start. There is nothing here so go to ROOM #2.

subject: Room 2
text: In Room 2, there are three little frogs that you can kill or ignore, then head North to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are three little frogs. You can kill them or ignore them and 
    head NORTH to ROOM #3.

subject: Room 3
text: In Room 3, defeating the crocodile among three swans and a frog opens a door to the North to Room 4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are 3 swans here, a frog and a crocodile. Once the crocodile 
    is defeated a door to the North will open up to ROOM #4.

subject: Hearts
text: In Room 4, grab the two hearts on the island to your right, and then head West to Room 5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    In this room is a swan and two frogs. There are two hearts on the 
    island to your right. Grab them if you need them and then head West 
    to ROOM #5.

subject: Room 5
text: In Room 5, defeat the three floating jellyfish to open the wall to the North leading to Room 6, while the hippopotamus does not have to be killed.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    This room has 3 floating jellyfish. Take them out and the wall to 
    the North will open up allowing you to proceed to ROOM #6. There is 
    also a hippopotamus but you don't have to kill him to get to the 
    next room.

subject: Room 6
text: In Savannah Dungeon A, Room 6 is the exit back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    Exit back to overworld.

subject: Monkey Maze Part 2
text: Legend for Monkey Maze Part 2 shows starting point O, big heart HH, exit X, and dead end DE.

evidence.quote:
- - - M O N K E Y  M A Z E  P A R T # 2 - - -

             LEGEND FOR MONKEY MAZE PART #2
                       O = Starting Point
                      HH = BIG HEART
                       X = Exit
                      DE = Dead End

subject: Big Heart
text: In the Savannah, go around and pick up the BIG HEART on the shore to the East.

evidence.quote:
You will want to go around and pick up 
    that BIG HEART over on the shore to the East

subject: Monkey Maze Part 2
text: From the BIG HEART, backtrack up to the top East, back down to the left, and up and around the Western part of the map to fall into another dungeon.

evidence.quote:
back track 
    up to the top East, back down to the left, and then up and around
    the Western part of the map. You should come out of the grass 
    clearing and then randomly fall down into another dungeon.

subject: Savannah Dungeon B
text: A map layout exists for Savannah Dungeon B spanning Rooms 1 through 7.

evidence.quote:
- - - S A V A N N A H  D U N G E O N   B - - -

                       LEGEND FOR SAVANNAH DUNGEON B
                       1 = Starting Point
                       7 = Exit

subject: Room 1
text: In Savannah Dungeon B Room 1, there is nothing, so go to Room 2.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #1:
    Here you start. There is nothing here so go to ROOM #2.

subject: Room 2
text: In Room 2, kill the two crocodiles among two swans to open the door and head North to Room 3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    We encounter 2 crocodiles and 2 swans here. You only need to kill 
    the crocodiles to open the door and head NORTH to ROOM #3.

subject: Hearts
text: In Room 3, grab the two hearts on the island to your right, and kill the crocodile among a jellyfish and three frogs to open the door North to Room 4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    In this room is a jellyfish, crocodile and three frogs. There are 
    two hearts on the island to your right. Grab them if you need them 
    and kill the crocodile to open the door and then head North to 
    ROOM #4.

subject: Room 4
text: In Room 4, kill the frogs while avoiding a jellyfish and a shooting hippopotamus to open the door and head North to Room 5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    When we first enter we see a frog and a jellyfish and shortly after 
    entering you'll see the hippopotamus appear and shoot at you. You 
    only need to kill the frogs to open the door and head NORTH to 
    ROOM #5.

subject: Big Scorpion
text: In ROOM #12, the Big Scorpion takes about 40 slingshot shots to defeat while scorpions come out of two holes in the wall.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    BOSS: BIG SCORPION
    When you enter this room you will see two holes in the wall at the 
    top. These holes will have scorpions come out of them during the 
    battle...It took me about 40 slingshot shots to take 
    him down.
